title: Explore What’s Possible
subtitle: Creative photography ideas using MobilePhoton apps.

scenarios.title: Star Trails
scenarios.shortDescription: Capture and combine a sequence of photos into smooth star trails.

content.heading: Capture the frames
content.body: Use Motion ProCam to capture a steady sequence of photos over time.

content.heading: Create the trail
content.body: Open the sequence in LightTrails and combine the frames into one photograph.

scenarios.title: Light Trails
scenarios.shortDescription: Turn moving lights at night into bright flowing lines.

content.heading: Find moving light
content.body: Traffic, bicycles, and handheld lights work well against a dark background.

content.heading: Build the final image
content.body: Capture a sequence and combine the brightest parts of each frame.

scenarios.title: Motion Blur
scenarios.shortDescription: Use intentional movement to create soft and expressive photographs.

content.heading: Choose the movement
content.body: Photograph moving water, people, traffic, or move the camera during capture.

content.heading: Adjust the result
content.body: Try different exposure times until the moving subject has the texture you want.
